text.content:
Sugar-skull faces on every corner of Vista del Rey.

Turf: Vista del Rey
Known for: Lookouts, hopping cars at Sunday shows, painting the names of Heywood's dead
Allies & rivals: Patron: the Valentinos

Vista del Rey kids in sugar-skull face paint. They watch the corners, hop the Valentinos' old cars at Sunday shows, and paint the names of Heywood's dead on the walls. When a Calaverita turns eighteen and wipes off the paint, the Valentinos are waiting.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
